marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind west 20 to 25 knots diminishing to west 10 to 15 after
midnight then becoming light late overnight. Wind light Thursday. Snow changing to flurries this morning and ending near noon
Thursday. Flurries Thursday evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
flurries. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
